lead.headline: Bedazzled Balls Alone at the Top
lead.deck: Fourth straight win, and now the league's only one-loss team.
paragraphs: {T12} got −1.0 from the Chiefs D/ST and 3.0 from Butker. The other seven starters carried it anyway.
Now 920.14 points for, most in the league, 10.60 ahead of {S8}. {S10}'s three-game win streak ends at 3–4.

sidebar.title: The Defense Led the Team
sidebar.text: The {S2} defense, projected for 4.6, scored 28.0 and outscored every Doughboy, bench included. Purdy managed 12.02.

12-10.headline: See Page One
12-10.text: Pony's Maye, Loveland and London combined for 66.94. Not nearly enough.

8-11.headline: Pollard Goes Off
8-11.text: Tony Pollard 36.5 from the flex, top player in the league. Burden added 23.7.

7-4.headline: Blowout of the Week
7-4.text: Stevenson 22.5, Jeanty 21.6. Bruisers' Nico Collins: 2.6 on a 16.7 projection.

9-6.headline: Travis Rides the Pickup
9-6.text: Javonte Williams 21.5, new add Kirk Cousins 20.4. IDK went 1–10 in all-play.

3-5.headline: First Win, Week Seven
3-5.text: McBride 27.1, Jacobs 20.1, Skattebo 19.1 on a 7.8 projection. Bo Nix 26.18 sat.

1-2.headline: Chimpanzini Makes It Three
1-2.text: Zay Flowers 27.7 on a 15.2 projection. Taylor 19.0, Gordon 17.3. Perfect lineup.

honor.title: Big Bedazzled Balls
honor.text: Aida was one of five perfect lineups this week, and the only one above 142.28. Started Jameson Williams on a 10.8 projection; he scored 26.1.

blotter.title: Benched the wrong receiver
blotter.text: Tee Higgins 26.8 sat. Garrett Wilson 4.6 started.

blotter.title: Zero at QB, again
blotter.text: Lamar Jackson, projected for zero, started for a second straight week.

missing.text: One of two IDK starters under 3.

pecking_notes.12: Only one-loss team. Won four straight.

forecast_blurbs.1-5: Two points. Closest line of the week.
forecast_blurbs.11-12: First place vs most points allowed.

3-5.headline: Even 8D Beat CeeDeez
3-5.text: {S3} was 0–6 and started three players projected for zero. Still won. {S5} posted a season-low 76.82, went 0–11 in all-play and started Breece Hall and Egbuka at zero.

7-4.headline: Four Straight Ls, Zero Excuses
7-4.text: {S4} started every right guy and still lost by 36.72. Fourth straight loss, now 1–6. {S7} rode Smith-Njigba's 31.3 to 5–2 like it was a ring ceremony.
